item.title: September 07, 2026 - Resentment and forgiveness
item.description: Page 261. "Where there has been wrong, the program teaches us the spirit of forgiveness." Just for Today: I will let go of my resentments. Today, if I am wronged, I will practice forgiveness, knowing that I need forgiveness myself.
